description: createContact: Create a new contact for use with domain registrations. Requires authentication. Returns the created contact including its id for assignment to domains.

country.description: Country as a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US'.

organization.description: Organization or company name, if any.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

state.description: State, province, or region, if applicable.

street2.description: Second street address line, if needed.

name: createContact
